label: Rust stock card demo
description: Drupal CMS plus a Rust web app in the same DDEV project. The Rust app shows stock cards (Yahoo Finance, with an embedded snapshot fallback) and pulls a random investing tip from Drupal's JSON:API.
agents_md: This project also runs a Rust web app (source in src/, served on port 8443 by a DDEV web_extra_daemon). It reads investing tips from Drupal's JSON:API at /jsonapi/node/investing_tip.
append_welcome_text: Try: Disney, AAPL, Nvidia. Edit an Investing tip in Drupal, then search again to see it change.
